name: little-chrome
title: Little Chrome
description: Open a URL or Google search in a minimal Chrome app window, like Little Arc.
author: tompenguin

commands.name: open-little-chrome
commands.title: Open Little Chrome
commands.description: Open a URL or search keyword in a small Chrome window

commands.name: copy-url
commands.title: Copy Chrome URL
commands.description: Copy the URL of the focused Chrome window (including Little Chrome windows)

commands.name: open-in-tab
commands.title: Open Little Chrome in Tab
commands.description: Move the focused Little Chrome window into a tab of a normal Chrome window

commands.name: manage-hidden
commands.title: Manage Hidden Suggestions
commands.description: List suggestions hidden from Open Little Chrome and unhide them

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
